operating_notes.text: Secured export order of ₹68.11 Cr (US$ 7.23 million) from USA for ERW Steel, OCTG Casing & tubing to be executed by June 2026.
Secured export order of ₹17.89 Cr (US$ 1.90 million) from USA for ERW Carbon Steel Pipe of API 5L Grade to be executed by June 2026.
Q4FY26 Steel Pipe & Strips segment result before tax and finance cost was ₹102.51 Cr on revenue of ₹1,662.11 Cr, against ₹142.08 Cr on ₹1,688.44 Cr in Q4FY25.
FY26 cash from operations was ₹400.66 Cr against net profit of ₹285.81 Cr; capex ₹159.76 Cr and dividend paid ₹119.70 Cr.
Net zero-debt status achieved with a cash surplus of ₹337 crore in FY26.
FY26 Steel Pipes value-added products were ~43% of volumes; hollow section pipes had highest-ever quarterly sales in Q4FY26.
Steel Pipes order book ₹1,000 Cr, mainly exports, spiral pipes and domestic API orders, with H1FY27 expected to be the highest value-added sale half.
Q4FY26 steel dispatch volumes were ~2.6 lakh tonnes, the highest quarterly dispatch.
Steel pipe manufacturing capacity increased to 1.4 million tons and is targeted to reach 1.6 million tons in FY27.

timeline.summary: Surya Roshni secured an export order of ₹68.11 Cr from the USA for ERW steel and OCTG casing.
Surya Roshni secured an export order of ₹17.89 Cr from the USA for ERW carbon steel pipes to be executed by June 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,163.25 Cr (+0.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹98.3 Cr (-24.4% YoY).
On 25 May 2026, Surya Roshni reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,163 Cr and PAT of ₹98 Cr, achieving a net cash surplus of ₹337 Cr.

On 25 May 2026, Surya Roshni's May 2026 investor presentation reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹7,540 Cr (+1%), EBITDA of ₹541 Cr (-11%) and PAT of ₹286 Cr (-18%), a ₹1,000 Cr steel order book and commissioning of a ₹50 Cr Malanpur spiral pipe line.
Surya Roshni Limited shared the earnings call recording link for Q4FY26 and FY26 results discussion on May 25, 2026, at 4:00 PM.
Surya Roshni hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding for FY27 revenue of ₹9,400-9,500 Cr and EBITDA of ₹680-700 Cr.
